fix_instructions: The primary failure mode is a disclosure/scenario-design problem driving both the turn-cap failures (rollouts 1, 3) and the wrong-path settlement (rollout 2). Add to shared_context an explicit statement that the robotic palletizer's current programming already supports integrated barcode scanning and family-group sorting, so A1 cannot raise it as an unresolved blocker. Secondarily, checks C1, C2, and C3 (linked to PF1) exhibit an ENCODING MISMATCH in rollout 2: PF1 was revealed and cited, but because the model chose manual mode, pre_run_setup_minutes and gripper_changeover_count were set to 0 instead of the expected 90 and 2. Either (a) reword C2 and C3 to accept 0/0 when palletizing_mode is manual, or (b) strengthen the shared_context so the robotic path is the only reasonable outcome once both facts are on the table. For the turn-cap failures in rollouts 1 and 3, the fix is the same shared_context clarification — once the integration question is pre-empted, the conversation should converge to settlement within the existing turn cap. No check wording changes are needed for C4, C5, C6, or P1 (linked to PF2), as these passed in every settled rollout.
